responsibility: Defines the C-SKY backend’s machine constraint language used by reload, register allocation, and instruction recognition in the .md files. It assigns register classes to constraint letters, describes valid memory-address forms through target helper predicates, and encodes the immediate ranges and special constant forms accepted by C-SKY instructions, including FPUv3 literal constants, so instruction patterns can discriminate legal operands and choose encodings without duplicating target-specific tests.
